item.title: Missouri women's basketball tops Lindenwood for 5-0 start | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The Missouri women’s basketball team is off to its first 5-0 start in four years following Sunday afternoon’s 79-63 victory against the Lindenwood Lions at Mizzou Arena. item.title: Mahomes throws five TD passes as Chiefs rout Falcons 35-13 | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: Patrick Mahomes completed 22-of-35 passes for 348 yards and five touchdowns to lead the Kansas City Chiefs to a 35-13 victory Sunday afternoon against the reeling Atlanta Falcons. Making his first start in place of the injured Kenneth Walker, rookie running back Emmett Johnson caught two touchdown passes and rushed for 101 yards as the Chiefs piled up 461 total yards.

item.title: NFL Capsules: Vikings stymie Packers in Cousins’ triumphant return | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: Kirk Cousins threw two touchdown passes in his return to the Minnesota Vikings, who forced four turnovers and amassed eight sacks in a dominant 30-10 victory Sunday afternoon against the Green Bay Packers in a crucial NFC North matchup. Cousins, who started 88 games for the Vikings from 2018-23, was reacquired last Tuesday from Las Vegas in exchange for a third-round draft pick. Cousins completed 21-of-31 passes for 207 yards with one interception. Justin Jefferson had a season-high nine receptions for 74 yards.
